items.title: Randy Brecker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 12, 2022
items.q: I guess his main claim to fame was he took Stan Getz’s place with Woody Herman.

ctx.x: Yeah. And he died pretty young I think, at 52 or 53. Wonderful player though. He’d played with — I guess his main claim to fame was he took Stan Getz’s place with Woody Herman. But lo and behold, like I said, I had no idea. In fact I found a record with all these cats on it where it’s kind of a comedy record where somebody’s narrating and they’re swinging along a couple choruses of blues, and somebody’s saying “here’s the way we want to play,” and then a couple of choruses later, “and here’s the way we have to…
May I ask how long your father lived and did he — was he able to see the success that you had as a musician?
